credits.title: Fatima
credits.overview: A dedicated Islamic exorcist navigating a barrage of terrifying supernatural disturbances must confront her deepest spiritual vulnerabilities when an ancient, malicious force threatens to destroy both her patients and her soul.

credits.title: Landslide
credits.overview: Separated from their mother during the chaotic Poso riots, a young boy and his older brother with Down syndrome join forces with a dedicated police officer, forging an unforgettable bond as they navigate deadly conflict to find her.

credits.title: Qorin 2
credits.overview: Fitri, a young guidance counselor, wants to uncover a bullying case involving one of her students. But Fitri's investigation leads her to a horrifying reality when she witnesses people connected to the case die one by one, only to reappear the next day.

credits.title: A Tale of Two Nomads
credits.overview: Amid government restrictions on ritual burning due to environmental concerns, 60-year-old Wang and 7-year-old Ming strive to fulfill a prayer boat offering for their departed loved ones.

credits.title: A Normal Woman
credits.overview: When an unidentified disease starts to upend her life, a socialite must unravel the mystery behind it — before her whole sense of self falls apart.

credits.title: Koesroyo: The Last Man Standing
credits.overview: A documentary that uncovering untold stories from Yok Koeswoyo & its musical milestone as the members of Koes Bersaudara/Koes Plus.

credits.title: Srimulat: Hil Yang Mustahal – Babak Pertama
credits.overview: Tells the story of the time when the comedy group Srimulat's career began to climb so that it became the first to appear on Indonesian national television.

credits.title: Asal Kau Bahagia
credits.overview: Ali had a severe accident that had to lie down in a coma. Although his body lays helpless and has to race between life and death, Ali's soul remained alive like a human being.

credits.title: Galih & Ratna
credits.overview: Two teenagers face demands from their families that do not care about what they want. They only have each other to encourage and pursue their dreams.
